title: Output prefix encoding
statement: For a Boolean list $w$, define its output prefix to be the concatenation of two true bits, the descriptor tail of $w$, and the two-bit list $(	ext{true},	ext{false})$.
caveat: The definition of the descriptor tail is not included, so its meaning cannot be specified further.
